definition: Delaying climax by pausing or reducing stimulation near the peak of arousal.
details: Requires clear communication and comfort. People use it to prolong arousal, intensify the eventual orgasm or practise ejaculatory control. It's closely related to the stop-start technique used for premature ejaculation. It's harmless; temporary pelvic heaviness ('blue balls') can happen and passes on its own. With a partner, agree on pace and signals.
